Follow the active development-agent-pipeline specification (AP2/AP10/AP13/AP14) and read the paired read-only implementation plan, especially section 'A4 bounded handoff-integrity pilot — concrete verification scenarios' with cases HI-01..HI-14. Treat that plan as advisory implementation guidance; do not weaken its owning normative contracts. In-scope behavior: numerically ordered attempt summaries, canonical filenames and strict integer identifiers, complete record consistency for latest worker and its saved snapshot, validated continuous histories, snapshot file/digest references whenever snapshots exist, no raw model logs/commands in the compact list, compatibility for no-worker and legacy single-worker runs. Add realistic deterministic regression tests for listed cases, including independent mutations of taskSha256, model, logSha256 and command. Fix inconsistent test fixtures rather than relaxing source/worktree integrity. Avoid policy, verification, risk, reviewer and acceptance lifecycle changes. Record material implementation-plan deviations with reasons. Do not claim historical snapshot immutability from a digest calculated only at handoff.
completionCriteria: All HI-01..HI-14 scenarios in the bound companion implementation plan have explicit regression coverage or documented principled limitations.
